labels: ΕΥΚΟΛΟ. Πιο ήπιες μάχες, περισσότερο περιθώριο αντίδρασης και περισσότερη ανάκτηση.
ΚΑΝΟΝΙΚΟ. Δυνατότερα χτυπήματα, ενισχύσεις και λιγότερη αυτόματη ανάκτηση. Συνδύασε επιθέσεις και άμυνα.
ΔΥΣΚΟΛΟ. Πιο ανθεκτικοί αντίπαλοι, πιο δυνατά χτυπήματα και λιγότερος χρόνος αντίδρασης.
EASY. Gentler battles, more time to react and more recovery.
NORMAL. Stronger hits, reinforcements and less automatic healing. Combine attacks with defence.
HARD. Tougher opponents, stronger attacks and less time to react.
ЛЕГКИЙ. Легші бої, більше часу на реакцію та краще відновлення.
ЗВИЧАЙНИЙ. Сильніші удари, підкріплення й менше автоматичного лікування. Поєднуй атаки із захистом.
СКЛАДНИЙ. Витриваліші вороги, сильніші удари й менше часу на реакцію.

balance.scope: Production damage/guard/HP formulas, 396 authored encounters across six regions/three difficulties/two seat counts in each browser; actual keyboard release and rendered carry source ownership. Deterministic diagnostics, not a human difficulty playtest.

holds.scope: Native source hand registration with composed inspection for both heroes; each body uses its fixed source camera

bosses.scope: Production boss AI, all three phases and six regions/difficulties/seats; legal-entry injected heavy damage, real KO progression and earliest reward pickup. Not a human campaign playthrough.

campaign.scope: Diagnostic traversal using legal-entry injected damage; actual contextual use/pickup and objective timers; not a human full campaign playthrough

gameplay.scope: Deterministic combat signatures, tactical damage, air input/physics, curated world structure; campaign completion is checked separately

checks: Both native image manifests resolve to local files
Review catalog covers forty-one enemies and six endings

baseline.scope: Accepted six-region arcade game with hit reactions, weather/audio, portrait handheld, destruction and bomber. Current checks focus on planted carry idle and distinct difficulty formulas/encounter pressure, with campaign and boss regressions.

limits: Campaign and boss diagnostics inject legal damage with invulnerable heroes; they are not a full human playthrough.
Browser emulation does not certify physical phone/gamepad behavior.
Existing native actor art is reused with fixed scale and original camera; no new painted animation atlas is claimed.
visualReview: Inspected both heroes standing with club and load in the composed city scene.
Native standing frames use planted feet, fixed body camera and per-hero grip; walking remains the existing eight-frame source.
Keyboard release selects idle and freezes travelled stride; actual final renderer samples the standing source instead of carry-walk.
